name: PTC Industries Limited
summary: PTC Industries Limited manufactures and sells high-precision metal castings in India and internationally. The company offers torque tubes, airframe structural components, engine mounts, turbine frames, engine liners, swirlers, and injectors for aircraft structures and propulsion systems; turbine frames, blades, buckets, vanes, inlet and outlet structures, and bearing housings for aero engines; and airframe structures, casings, bearing housings, refueling nozzles, turbine oil tanks, and engine gear boxes for air defense, as well as other casings for land defense.
